6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Just as I started to relax, I caught the faint sound of footsteps.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: When I turned to look, I saw Manus Sazon emerging from the shadow of an ancient oak.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: When I turned to look, I saw Grand Wiseman Ignacius emerging from the shadow of an ancient oak.

13.speaker: Manus Sazon
13.text: "May I have a word with you, please?"

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "I'm sorry, but I need to be somewhere else."

18.speaker: Manus Sazon
18.text: "It pertains to our prior discussions on potential reforms."
18.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.VinaManus_Together"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false)

24.speaker: Manus Sazon
24.text: "I came here to discuss an important matter."

25.speaker: Manus Sazon
25.text: "Thank you. I know your time is precious."

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "I'm sorry, Manus, but I've had a change of heart regarding our cooperation."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "Great. I was expecting some news from you."

29.speaker: Manus Sazon
29.text: "It's related to the growing unrest among the population. People are flocking to our ranks."
29.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.VinaManus_Together"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false)

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "I'm sorry, Manus. But allowing dissenters to join your movement is a mistake."

32.speaker: Player_Romus
32.text: "Great. I've been expecting an update from you."

33.speaker: Player_Romus
33.text: "I can't associate with you anymore. You must leave the palace immediately."

37.speaker: Player_Romus
37.text: "My council just informed me that your movement is beginning to make trouble. What do you have to say for yourself?"

41.speaker: Player_Romus
41.text: "My council just informed me that your movement is beginning to stir things up. What do you have to say for yourself?"

44.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
44.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false) == false

45.speaker: Player_Romus
45.text: "What are you doing in the palace?  I've been informed you're now considered a national security threat."

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "I can no longer be associated with you or your reforms. You must leave the palace immediately."

54.speaker: Player_Romus
54.text: "I can no longer be associated with your reforms. If you still want to marry my daughter, you need to immediately distance yourself from this movement."

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "I hope you understand my reasons. I'm sorry."

71.speaker: Manus Sazon
71.text: "Well, then, Your Majesty. I'll leave you alone for the time being."

73.speaker: Player_Romus
73.text: "This goes beyond reforms. I need you to explain your involvement in the recent unrest."

74.speaker: Player_Romus
74.text: "I trust you won't stray from the path or do anything that would jeopardize your marriage to my daughter, Manus."

78.speaker: Player_Romus
78.text: "What are you still doing here? You can leave now."

86.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
86.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true))

87.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
87.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true))) == false

93.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true  and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_ElectoralReform"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false)) == false

97.speaker: Manus Sazon
97.text: "The citizens of this nation are growing increasingly discontent, flocking to the RPP or RPP-aligned groups in a bid to make their voices heard."

98.speaker: Manus Sazon
98.text: "There's been a widespread public outcry against the government..."
98.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true))) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true  and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_ElectoralReform"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false)) == false)

99.speaker: Manus Sazon
99.text: "You cannot deny that living conditions for commoners have worsened. People want an end to the suffering."
99.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true)))

100.speaker: Manus Sazon
100.text: "You cannot deny that living conditions for commoners have worsened, especially since the war began. People want an end to the suffering."
100.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true))) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true)

101.speaker: Manus Sazon
101.text: "Despite winning a majority in the election, our primary demands remain unfulfilled. which has incensed much of the opposition."
101.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true))) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true  and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_ElectoralReform"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false))

102.speaker: Manus Sazon
102.text: "And yes, some within the RPP are now outright calling for an end to the monarchy."

103.speaker: Manus Sazon
103.text: "To be perfectly honest... the sheer scale of this unrest is not something the RPP can ignore."
103.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_Religious_Grows"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_Nationalist_Grows"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == false)

107.speaker: Manus Sazon
107.text: "Not to mention the Wruhecist community and the clergy, who have also joined our movement."

111.speaker: Manus Sazon
111.text: "Not to mention the Rizian nationalists who have also joined our movement."
111.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_Religious_Grows"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_Nationalist_Grows"] == true)

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "You act as if your party isn't facilitating the unrest."

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "If you can't contain this mess, I'll have no choice but to hold you personally responsible."

115.speaker: Player_Romus
115.text: "What do you want me to do?"

116.speaker: Manus Sazon
116.text: "The demand for reform is growing larger and larger, Your Majesty. It would be foolish to ignore it."

117.speaker: Manus Sazon
117.text: "We are their only option, Your Majesty. It's not our party's prowess in propaganda that brings people in; it's the state of the country that drives them to us."

118.speaker: Manus Sazon
118.text: "We are doing our best, but there's only so much we can do."

125.speaker: Manus Sazon
125.text: "Forgive my bluntness, Your Majesty, but it's imperative that you strive to improve living standards. The commoners have suffered for long enough."

126.speaker: Manus Sazon
126.text: "Such a strategy could have a significant impact. I only hope it's not too late."

127.speaker: Manus Sazon
127.text: "Forgive my bluntness, Your Majesty, but it's imperative that you stop the war as soon as possible. People want an end to the bloodshed."
127.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true)

128.speaker: Manus Sazon
128.text: "Taking that step would have a significant impact. I only hope it's not too late."

129.speaker: Manus Sazon
129.text: "Forgive my bluntness, Your Majesty, but people are fed up with our current system of governance."
129.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true) == false)

130.speaker: Manus Sazon
130.text: "Which is why right now is the time to enact the democratic reforms this country has been waiting for, Your Majesty."

137.speaker: Manus Sazon
137.text: "I know you and I are in agreement about this. As was Her Highness, before..."

138.speaker: Manus Sazon
138.text: "You were interested in committing to a new direction for the country at one point. I believe we should return to that discussion."

139.speaker: Manus Sazon
139.text: "Don't stand in the way of change, Your Majesty. I firmly believe that the time has come to embrace a democratic direction for our country."

142.speaker: Manus Sazon
142.text: "My fellow reformists and I believe the time has come to make these theories and exchanges of ideas into a reality."

143.speaker: Player_Romus
143.text: "I held onto that belief until this movement took a radical turn. I'm sorry, Manus, but our collaboration ends here."

145.speaker: Player_Romus
145.text: "All right. Tell me what you have in mind."

146.speaker: Player_Romus
146.text: "I held onto that belief until this movement took a radical turn. I'm sorry, Manus, but my priorities have shifted."

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "These people... they're not like you or me. I can't enter into a dialogue with them."

152.speaker: Manus Sazon
152.text: "With all due respect, Your Majesty, these are sons and daughters of Rizia, just like us."

153.speaker: Player_Romus
153.text: "You've got it wrong. They are the ones forsaking their loyalty to the Crown, forgetting where their allegiance lies."

154.speaker: Player_Romus
154.text: "A king must always maintain a distance from his subjects. From above, he can see the greater picture that they cannot."

155.speaker: Player_Romus
155.text: "I trust you understand my rationale. I'm sorry."

157.speaker: Narrator
157.text: He let out a deep sigh.

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "You're trying to use this situation for your own benefit, aren't you?"

159.speaker: Player_Romus
159.text: "Are you certain that you can leverage this opportunity to our advantage? How do you know the people in this movement will support our reforms?"

160.speaker: Manus Sazon
160.text: "They will if we act fast. I'm certain of it."

162.speaker: Manus Sazon
162.text: "Nothing in this is about me, Your Majesty."

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "Maybe you're right. I've been thinking about transferring some of my power, anyway."

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "You will immediately stop representing the reform movement. Or you will pay. Do you hear me?"

167.speaker: Manus Sazon
167.text: "I know you and I are in agreement that Rizia needs a change in direction. As was Her Highness, before..."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "I believed that before, but the war has proven that Rizia needs a strong monarch. I'm sorry, but our collaboration ends here."

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "I'm sorry, Manus, but my priorities have changed."

173.speaker: Narrator
173.text: He motioned toward a secluded corner of the garden, nestled beneath a tree. As we made our way there, his voice softened to a whisper.

174.speaker: Manus Sazon
174.text: "Rizia is considered a 'constitutional monarchy', yet lacks a written constitution to define and safeguard its principles."

175.speaker: Manus Sazon
175.text: "We have to make sure nobody has the ability to intervene or execute a power grab before the new constitution is signed."

176.speaker: Manus Sazon
176.text: "Should the King personally engage in drafting this constitution and align with the House majority in its proclamation, no authority in Rizia can denounce its legitimacy."

177.speaker: Player_Romus
177.text: "Our relatives will never recognize a constitution they did not take part in. They still have the power to deem it illegitimate."

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "If it becomes public knowledge that we're set on reform, we'll both become targets for the monarchists."

179.speaker: Player_Romus
179.text: "Easier said than done. What is your plan?"

180.speaker: Manus Sazon
180.text: "We have to play it smart, Your Majesty."

181.speaker: Manus Sazon
181.text: "We can strategize together on how to proceed with such a declaration. However, that will hinge on the specific content of the reforms in question."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "This isn’t the place for such discussions. Someone may hear us. Let's start drafting a constitution and planning our strategy somewhere more secure." [Proceed With Reforms]

183.speaker: Player_Romus
183.text: "I've entertained your fantasies for long enough. But the truth is, I've grown rather attached to my power as a monarch. I'm not interested in reforming the kingdom."

185.speaker: Narrator
185.text: He sighed and then bowed his head.

186.speaker: Manus Sazon
186.text: "Thank you for your time anyway, Your Majesty."

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "Be careful, Manus. I wouldn't want anything unfortunate to befall you."

188.speaker: Player_Romus
188.text: "Just try to distance yourself from all this. For your own sake."

189.speaker: Player_Romus
189.text: "I appreciate you sharing all this information with me."

191.speaker: Narrator
191.text: Manus offered one final bow before departing.

192.speaker: Sal Ignacius
192.text: "May I have a word with you, please?"

196.speaker: Sal Ignacius
196.text: "It's related to the growing unrest among the population. I have some concerns and suggestions I'd like to discuss with you, if I may."

197.speaker: Sal Ignacius
197.text: "Your Majesty... I represent the Sanctuary of Rizian Wruhecism. Which in turn represents a majority of Rizians."

198.speaker: Player_Romus
198.text: "I'm sorry, Sal. But I don't see why you're interested in this."

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "All right. What is it you want to tell me?"

201.speaker: Sal Ignacius
201.text: "Your Majesty... the situation on the ground is far bleaker than what your other councilors have conveyed."

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "Listen to me, Sal. I need you to ensure that the Sanctuary doesn't support this movement."

208.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
208.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true))

209.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
209.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true))) == false

213.speaker: Sal Ignacius
213.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true))) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true) == false)

214.speaker: Sal Ignacius
214.text: "They are demanding an end to the dreadful conditions they are enduring."
214.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true)))

215.speaker: Sal Ignacius
215.text: "They are pleading for an end to the war and the suffering it has caused them."
215.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_FreePress"] == false  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible"] == true  or   Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad"] == true))) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad"] == true)

216.speaker: Sal Ignacius
216.text: "The key to coming out stronger from this mess is to convince Wruhecists, as a whole, to stand by the Crown and oppose the reformists."

221.speaker: Sal Ignacius
221.text: "By aligning with them, they can act as a bulwark against the reformists, and help restore stability."

225.speaker: Sal Ignacius
225.text: "As a devout Wruhecist yourself, you can use this opportunity to bring God's will to Rizia."

226.speaker: Sal Ignacius
226.text: "I am sorry I could not be of use to you."

227.speaker: Player_Romus
227.text: "I see you're attempting to use this situation to your own advantage."

228.speaker: Player_Romus
228.text: "Very well. If it means peace, I will change the law to appease Wruhecists."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "No, Sal. I'm not with you on this."

230.speaker: Sal Ignacius
230.text: "I am just the messenger, Your Majesty."

232.speaker: Player_Romus
232.text: "You are right. The time has come."

233.speaker: Player_Romus
233.text: "Halaita, Grand Wiseman. We shall instill the fear of God into our enemies."

234.speaker: Player_Romus
234.text: "Absolutely out of the question. We shouldn't taint our cherished religious beliefs with politics."

235.speaker: Player_Romus
235.text: "An intriguing perspective. I'm open to partnering with the Wruhecist community."

239.speaker: Sal Ignacius
239.text: "Praise God! I had faith you'd eventually come around."

240.speaker: Narrator
240.text: I saw the sudden disappointment in his eyes.

242.speaker: Sal Ignacius
242.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_Religious_Grows"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveStateReligion"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveStateReligion"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == false) == false)

243.speaker: Narrator
243.text: He motioned toward a secluded corner of the garden, shaded by a Galmish baobab tree.

244.speaker: Sal Ignacius
244.text: "Tell me, Your Majesty, are you ready to rectify the mistakes of the past and unify our country under the doctrine of Wruhecism?"

245.speaker: Sal Ignacius
245.text: "As you know, the clergy commands considerable authority within Rizia's Wruhecist community -- extending our reach even into institutions like the military."

246.speaker: Sal Ignacius
246.text: "For, if the King unites with the Sanctuary and uphold God's laws in Rizia, no other power in the kingdom could oppose us."

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "The Houses will never accept the law of the Divine as law of the land."

250.speaker: Sal Ignacius
250.text: "If we were to harness the strength of these followers -- to create an army of God, as it were -- such a coalition would bolster the Crown's authority like never before."

251.speaker: Sal Ignacius
251.text: "Should you wish, it would be my honor to discuss this proposal further."

252.speaker: Player_Romus
252.text: "I am ready to fulfill God's will."

253.speaker: Player_Romus
253.text: "Sorry, I cannot permit Rizia to lose its sovereignty to theocratic extremism. Not on my watch. This discussion ends now."

254.speaker: Player_Romus
254.text: "Uh... I think that's going a little too far, Sal. I'm sorry, but I've got to leave."

255.speaker: Sal Ignacius
255.text: "Thank you for your time, Your Majesty. May God be with you."

256.speaker: Player_Romus
256.text: "Take heed, Grand Wiseman. While divine salvation is profound, it may not shield you from... earthly perils."

257.speaker: Player_Romus
257.text: "Just try to distance yourself from all this. For your own sake."

258.speaker: Player_Romus
258.text: "Thank you for sharing all of this with me. I appreciate it."

260.speaker: Narrator
260.text: He offered one final bow before departing.

264.speaker: Sal Ignacius
264.text: "May God bless your soul, Your Majesty."

267.speaker: Player_Romus
267.text: "In the name of the prophet -- peace be upon him -- we will prevail."

269.speaker: Narrator
269.text: The Grand Wiseman offered one final bow before departing, leaving Titus with a stunned look on his face.

270.speaker: Manus Sazon
270.text: "Of course. I'll reach out at a more convenient time."

271.speaker: Manus Sazon
271.text: "I will have some proposals for our action plan by then. Have a good day, Your Majesty."

272.speaker: Narrator
272.text: He bowed, then took his leave.
272.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Religion_Leaning_Theocratic"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Happy"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true)) == false

273.speaker: Sal Ignacius
273.text: "Let us support the faithful in their struggle to reach Golconda, by assembling a special religious order..."

274.speaker: Sal Ignacius
274.text: "An elite task force of spiritual warriors whose sworn duty is to ensure that the laws of God are upheld, and your authority isn't challenged."

277.speaker: Player_Romus
277.text: "I am not comfortable with this, Grand Wiseman. Establishing a morality police is not how I intend to solidify my authority."

278.speaker: Player_Romus
278.text: "I appreciate the proposal, Grand Wiseman, but I don't think Rizia is ready for such a drastic change."

279.speaker: Narrator
279.text: I saw the sudden disappointment in his eyes.

281.speaker: Sal Ignacius
281.text: "Very good. Now, we must discuss the question of leadership."

282.speaker: Titus Gordion
282.text: "Thank you both. I promise I won't fail you."

283.speaker: Sal Ignacius
283.text: "By the grace of St. Wruhec, you shall not falter."

variablesModified.value: "Under the reign of King Romus Toras, the Golden Guard was enlarged into a division-sized unit and given expanded duties. Later, the special religious division Wruhec's Guardians was added."
"Under the reign of King Romus Toras, the Golden Guard expanded to include a new religious division, Wruhec's Guardians."

288.speaker: Sal Ignacius
288.text: "It pertains to our earlier discussions regarding the role of religion in Rizia."

293.speaker: Sal Ignacius
293.text: "I can't stop thinking about the vision you and I shared."

294.speaker: Narrator
294.text: We began a leisurely stroll through the garden.

295.speaker: Sal Ignacius
295.text: "No matter what, my reasoning always leads me to the same conclusion..."

296.speaker: Sal Ignacius
296.text: "Unfortunately, our current laws hinder us from transforming this country into the sacred realm it's destined to become."

300.speaker: Sal Ignacius
300.text: "It is imperative that our state religion be Wruhecist, Your Majesty. We need to establish a faith-based order for future generations to come."

301.speaker: Sal Ignacius
301.text: "Wruhecism is an integral part of our daily lives and must play a defining role in our schools and institutions."

305.speaker: Sal Ignacius
305.text: "With our current laws, we have an excellent foundation for such a transformation."

306.speaker: Sal Ignacius
306.text: "If you sign a decree mandating Wruhecist education in our schools, my followers and I will ensure it passes with minimal effort."

307.speaker: Player_Romus
307.text: "Are you sure about this? Is it truly the path that has been chosen for me?"

308.speaker: Sal Ignacius
308.text: "And now, we stand before a threshold to a new era, with you holding the keys."

309.speaker: Sal Ignacius
309.text: "At this very moment, we stand before a threshold to a new era, with you holding the keys."

310.speaker: Player_Romus
310.text: "Now that I think about it, I realize my previous remarks were made in haste. Rizia's governance will stay as it is."

311.speaker: Sal Ignacius
311.text: "All that's needed is for you to open it and lead your people through."

313.speaker: Narrator
313.text: He spoke the words with intense conviction.

314.speaker: Player_Romus
314.text: "Then I will open it. I will do whatever is necessary to enshrine Wruhecism into Rizian law."

315.speaker: Sal Ignacius
315.text: "I see. Forgive me if I was too hasty. I just thought... that you were ready to have this conversation."

318.speaker: Player_Romus
318.text: "Don't worry. I don't blame you for trying."

319.speaker: Sal Ignacius
319.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveStateReligion"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveStateReligion"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == false) == false)

320.speaker: Sal Ignacius
320.text: "I can see it clearly now, Your Majesty. That the Almighty sent you here for a reason."

325.speaker: Sal Ignacius
325.text: "I won't take up any more of your time. I have important duties to attend to."

328.speaker: Player_Romus
328.text: "I don't believe I hold *that* level of importance."

329.speaker: Sal Ignacius
329.text: "I never doubted it for a moment."

330.speaker: Sal Ignacius
330.text: "Oh, but time will tell. Time will tell."

331.speaker: Sal Ignacius
331.text: "It will reveal itself to you when the time is right."

332.speaker: Narrator
332.text: Sal motioned towards a secluded corner of the garden, nestled beneath a tree. His voice softened to a whisper as we approached.

333.speaker: Sal Ignacius
333.text: "The significance of our religious laws cannot be overstated. However, they mark the beginning, not the end..."

334.speaker: Sal Ignacius
334.text: "The clergy wields significant influence within Rizia's Wruhecist community, with their reach extending into institutions such as the military."

335.speaker: Sal Ignacius
335.text: "If we were to unite them -- an army of God, if you will -- such a coalition would bolster the Crown's authority like never before."

365.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
365.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.VinaManus_Together"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false

366.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
366.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.VinaManus_Together"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false

371.speaker: Manus Sazon
371.text: "Actually, that isn't why I'm here. There's another topic I urgently need to bring up with you."

372.speaker: Manus Sazon
372.text: "I suppose I'll see you in the House of Delegates. Give my best regards to the Princess."

376.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
376.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Religion_Leaning_Theocratic"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Happy"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true)) == false

381.speaker: Narrator
381.text: As I rounded a curve in the path, the garden revealed itself in all its splendor.

382.speaker: Narrator
382.text: Manicured hedges surrounded patches of blooming flowers, with ornate lamps on wrought-iron posts shedding light over the twisting gravel paths.

383.speaker: Narrator
383.text: It was a stark contrast to the austere council chambers I had just left.

384.speaker: Manus Sazon
384.text: "To distance yourself from them is to distance yourself from your own humanity."

385.speaker: Manus Sazon
385.text: "It's time the Crown transferred its law-making powers to elected representatives."

386.speaker: Manus Sazon
386.text: "Then we'll have to make sure nobody has the ability to intervene or execute a power grab before the new constitution is signed."

387.speaker: Narrator
387.text: Manus looked at me in shock and disbelief.

388.speaker: Narrator
388.text: He couldn't bring himself to finish the sentence.

390.speaker: Manus Sazon
390.text: "Their cries for civil liberties are reaching a fever pitch."

391.speaker: Sal Ignacius
391.text: "A governance rooted in faith -- one that embraces God's law above the laws of men -- is not just the best choice, but the only way forward for Rizia."

393.speaker: Player_Romus
393.text: "So you're still hell-bent on establishing a divine monarchy."

397.speaker: Sal Ignacius
397.text: "I like to think of it more as a holy *liberation*."

398.speaker: Sal Ignacius
398.text: "Your faith-based decrees have paved the way for a prosperous future."

399.speaker: Sal Ignacius
399.text: "The classroom is the place to reinforce religious teachings, instilling values that uphold our cultural identity and moral principles."

400.speaker: Narrator
400.text: As we made our way there, his voice softened to a whisper.

401.speaker: Sal Ignacius
401.text: "Praise God! I had faith you'd eventually come around."
401.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_Religious_Grows"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveStateReligion"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveStateReligion"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == false) == false)

402.speaker: Sal Ignacius
402.text: "Faith teaches that divine providence guides us through all trials, both spiritual and earthly. Those who challenge it often find themselves on precarious ground."

404.speaker: Sal Ignacius
404.text: "All that's needed is for you to open it and lead your people through."

405.speaker: Narrator
405.text: Sal's eyes went wide, but he maintained his composure.

407.speaker: Sal Ignacius
407.text: "Well, I appreciate your honesty. Though, I can't say I'm not disappointed."

411.speaker: Manus Sazon
411.text: "To be perfectly honest... the sheer scale of this unrest is not something I can manage or control on my own."
411.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_Religious_Grows"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_Nationalist_Grows"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == false) == false)

412.speaker: Manus Sazon
412.text: "I have some important news for you. I wanted you to hear this from me instead of the Grand Vizier."

413.speaker: Manus Sazon
413.text: "The anti-monarchists within the RPP have infiltrated the party leadership. They voted me out of my position today. They will make the announcement this week."

414.speaker: Narrator
414.text: He lowered his head with an ashamed look in his eyes.

415.speaker: Manus Sazon
415.text: "Certain individuals have taken advantage of the rising discontent in Rizia to introduce ideas that would have been considered far too radical in the past."

416.speaker: Player_Romus
416.text: "Let me guess. The new leader's named Adarfo."

417.speaker: Manus Sazon
417.text: "I see you're already aware of the situation."

418.speaker: Player_Romus
418.text: "Are you telling me that RPP has been infiltrated by communists?"

419.speaker: Player_Romus
419.text: "What? How did you allow this to happen? I thought the RPP listened to you."

421.speaker: Player_Romus
421.text: "And who did they appoint in your place?"

422.speaker: Player_Romus
422.text: "If you can't nip this in the bud, I'll have no choice but to hold you personally responsible."

423.speaker: Manus Sazon
423.text: "I'm sorry, Your Majesty. I did my best."

424.speaker: Manus Sazon
424.text: "They elected Adarfo Sotelato, a relatively new member of the party. He has been leading the left-wing faction of the RPP."

425.speaker: Manus Sazon
425.text: "Yes. Mr. Sotelato is the new leader. The left-wing faction officially took over the RPP."

426.speaker: Manus Sazon
426.text: "He and they are the driving force behind the recent protests."

427.speaker: Manus Sazon
427.text: "I did my best to convince my fellow party members of the merits of a slow democratic change that respected our traditions and the Crown..."

431.speaker: Manus Sazon
431.text: "Which is why we absolutely must take the situation seriously, Your Majesty."

432.speaker: Manus Sazon
432.text: "... But I have failed the RPP, Your Majesty. The people are too fed up with the state of the Kingdom to patiently wait for change to come. They want to abolish the Crown."

433.speaker: Player_Romus
433.text: "This is your mess. I can no longer associate with you. Leave the palace immediately."

434.speaker: Player_Romus
434.text: "I am willing to listen to the new voices in your party."

435.speaker: Player_Romus
435.text: "I don't care what you have to say, Manus. You're no longer relevant to this movement. I want to meet with Adarfo Sotelato."

436.speaker: Player_Romus
436.text: "I can no longer be associated with you. If you still want to marry my daughter, you need to immediately distance yourself from this movement."

440.speaker: Manus Sazon
440.text: "Which is why we must finally push the democratic reforms we've been collaborating on, Your Majesty. It's the only way out of this mess."

441.speaker: Player_Romus
441.text: "If reforming the kingdom means appeasing radicals like Sotelato, then I am no longer interested."

442.speaker: Player_Romus
442.text: "And what about the communists taking charge? What about the unrest? You must be held responsible for this."

443.speaker: Player_Romus
443.text: "I'm listening. What do you want me to do?"

444.speaker: Player_Romus
444.text: "You are no longer in charge of the RPP. I think that changes the nature of our collaboration."

446.speaker: Manus Sazon
446.text: "You can use this opportunity to declare your intention to transform Rizia into a more democratic monarchy."

447.speaker: Manus Sazon
447.text: "I will take all the responsibility for it, Your Majesty. But it is the state of the country that's pushing this faction to radicalism. And I have done my best to keep the movement peaceful."

449.speaker: Player_Romus
449.text: "I am taking it seriously. If the unrest turns violent, Sotelato and his sheep will all pay."

450.speaker: Manus Sazon
450.text: "My people and I have been working on these reforms for a long time. Adarfo's leadership doesn't negate everything we've done so far."

451.speaker: Manus Sazon
451.text: "This should calm the radicals and appease the public, as well as put pressure on the nobles and the royal houses not to outright oppose it."

452.speaker: Manus Sazon
452.text: "If we plan this right, we can transform Rizia and quell the unrest in one fell swoop."

453.speaker: Manus Sazon
453.text: "But if you really want to talk to him, I can try to organize a meeting."

454.speaker: Manus Sazon
454.text: "But I hope it won't come to that."

455.speaker: Player_Romus
455.text: "He will listen to me or I will have his head."

456.speaker: Player_Romus
456.text: "Don't worry. I will talk some sense into him."

457.speaker: Player_Romus
457.text: "I don't see a problem with listening to him. As a matter of fact, I *may* be willing to abdicate."

458.speaker: Player_Romus
458.text: "Maybe you're right. I shouldn't associate myself with him."

459.speaker: Manus Sazon
459.text: "I'm not sure if you should, Your Majesty. Sotelato is not a reformist. He will be satisfied with nothing less than your abdication."

460.speaker: Player_Romus
460.text: "It's too risky. I'm afraid I'll have to pass."

461.speaker: Player_Romus
461.text: "I don't want to talk about this at all. I'm no longer interested in reforms."

462.speaker: Player_Romus
462.text: "You've convinced me. What are our next steps?"

468.speaker: Manus Sazon
468.text: "I will do my best to calm the situation within the RPP. But please try to address their concerns, Your Majesty."

475.speaker: Player_Romus
475.text: "You're no longer relevant, Manus. I doubt we'll meet again soon."

476.speaker: Narrator
476.text: Manus offered one final bow and left without saying anything.

479.speaker: Manus Sazon
479.text: "Then I will do my best to convince him not to refuse a King's invitation."

480.speaker: Manus Sazon
480.text: "If you'll excuse me, I will get right to it."

481.speaker: Player_Romus
481.text: "Any revolutionary action against the monarchy must be swiftly crushed, Manus. I cannot tolerate this."

482.speaker: Manus Sazon
482.text: "I completely understand, Your Majesty. Sotelato poses a threat to my family as well as yours."

484.speaker: Manus Sazon
484.text: "You can use the scale of the unrest on the streets to demonstrate the public demand for reform. You would hold the upper hand."
484.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true)

488.speaker: Manus Sazon
488.text: "Now that the RPP is in charge of the House, the preparations for reforms have begun in earnest."

489.speaker: Manus Sazon
489.text: "The reformists still remain the minority in the House. This puts us in a weaker legal position to prepare a new constitution."

490.speaker: Manus Sazon
490.text: "Nonetheless, my fellow reformists believe we shouldn't wait any longer. We must seize the chance to make our ideas a reality."

494.speaker: Manus Sazon
494.text: "Should the King personally engage in drafting this constitution with the reformists and publicly appease Sotelato's faction by including them in the process, the reforms will have both public support and legitimacy."

501.speaker: Manus Sazon
501.text: "Should the King personally engage in drafting this constitution with the reformists and publicly appease the protesters by declaring his intentions, the reforms will have both public support and legitimacy."
501.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true)

502.speaker: Manus Sazon
502.text: "Should the King personally engage in drafting this constitution, and should its terms align with those of the reformist movement, it will have the support it needs to become legitimate."
502.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true) == false)

503.speaker: Player_Romus
503.text: "The noble houses are troubled enough by the anti-monarchist unrest. If we try to include the troublemakers in the process, we'll become targets."

504.speaker: Player_Romus
504.text: "By cooperating with the people who are deemed radical dissenters, we'll both become targets for the monarchists."

505.speaker: Player_Romus
505.text: "They will not allow us to declare a new constitution with the minority party while simultaneously going over the nobles' heads."

509.speaker: Manus Sazon
509.text: "With me as the Speaker of the House, and our movement representing the majority, we still hold the upper hand."
509.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false)

513.speaker: Manus Sazon
513.text: "With the scale of the unrest on the streets, you can use the momentum to divert the radicalism into support for reform."

514.speaker: Player_Romus
514.text: "There may be no point in those reforms anymore, Manus. Perhaps the Rizian monarchy truly has reached its end."

516.speaker: Manus Sazon
516.text: "I know you've expressed such intentions before, but..."

521.speaker: Player_Romus
521.text: "You just admitted that the RPP is in a weak position. How is now the right time to act?"

522.speaker: Player_Romus
522.text: "It is too risky to proceed with this while Daria still leads the House, Manus. I'm not sure now is the right time."

523.speaker: Manus Sazon
523.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false)

524.speaker: Manus Sazon
524.text: "The reformists are getting restless, Your Majesty. And our failure in the election only heightened that."

528.speaker: Manus Sazon
528.text: "The Grand Vizier may try to hide the fact that our ideas are winning over the people. But our movement has grown dramatically in the last years."

529.speaker: Manus Sazon
529.text: "Our members wants us to act. This isn't only about the House of Delegates, this is about the Rizian people."

531.speaker: Manus Sazon
531.text: "If you support us, we won't be in a weaker position. You have the means at your disposal to see this through."

532.speaker: Manus Sazon
532.text: "If you support us, we won't be in a weaker position. You have the means at your disposal to see this through."

535.speaker: Player_Romus
535.text: "I have considered it, and my answer is no."

536.speaker: Player_Romus
536.text: "It's too risky, Manus. I won't be going ahead with the reforms anymore. And frankly, you should also stop pushing."

537.speaker: Player_Romus
537.text: "I'm sorry, but the answer is no."

544.speaker: Player_Romus
544.text: "What are you doing in the palace?  I've been informed your movement is challenging you and stirring up unrest."

546.speaker: Player_Romus
546.text: "I told you this was my aim, and you didn't listen to me. Perhaps Sotelato will."

547.speaker: Player_Romus
547.text: "Of course I'm not fucking serious. Any revolutionary action against the monarch must be swiftly crushed. I cannot tolerate this."

548.speaker: Player_Romus
548.text: "Yes. Forget about your reforms, Manus. I want you to set me up a meeting with Adarfo."

549.speaker: Player_Romus
549.text: "Do you have a better idea? You're an outcast in your party. I think that limits our chances of success."

550.speaker: Manus Sazon
550.text: "Mr. Sotelato is against everything the nobility stands for, Your Majesty. He will be satisfied with nothing less than your abdication."

554.speaker: Manus Sazon
554.text: "We can still try to push for reform, Your Majesty. It would appease the dissenters."

558.speaker: Narrator
558.text: He couldn't bring himself to finish the sentence.

559.speaker: Manus Sazon
559.text: "I know you and I are in agreement about this. As is Her Highness."

565.speaker: Player_Romus
565.text: "I'm fighting a war, son. We can think about reforms once the enemy has been defeated."

566.speaker: Manus Sazon
566.text: "We'll tear ourselves apart from inside before that happens! These reforms can't wait."

571.speaker: Player_Romus
571.text: "One more word out of you, and the wedding is off."

575.speaker: Player_Romus
575.text: "All right. Tell me what you have in mind."

589.speaker: Player_Romus
589.text: "Please do. It's time for the nobility to step aside. That means both of us."

590.speaker: Player_Romus
590.text: "If you want to marry my daughter, you will get your party under control as soon as possible."

594.speaker: Manus Sazon
594.text: "I know you and I are in agreement that Rizia needs a change in direction."

599.speaker: Player_Romus
599.text: "Her Highness is marrying the Duke of another monarchy. We'll all have to put our democratic visions on hold for the time being."

602.speaker: Narrator
602.text: After he left, I became aware of another presence in the garden. That of Grand Wiseman Ignacius.

606.speaker: Player_Romus
606.text: "Wruhecism isn't even our state religion anymore. You're irrelevant, Sal."

607.speaker: Sal Ignacius
607.text: "Faith will always be important in this kingdom. Even if it does not say so on paper."

608.speaker: Sal Ignacius
608.text: "The Archpriests and Wisemen I talk to have spoken of widespread discontent. Ordinary people, even those without a reformist bone in their bodies, are aligning with the RPP in desperation."

609.speaker: Sal Ignacius
609.text: "But first, you must earn back their trust."

613.speaker: Sal Ignacius
613.text: "Which you lost when you removed Wruhecism as this kingdom's state religion."

617.speaker: Sal Ignacius
617.text: "The faithful have long been demanding the integration of Wruhecism into the Rizian school curriculum."

618.speaker: Sal Ignacius
618.text: "Sign a decree mandating a Wruhecist education for every Rizian child, and my followers will ensure it passes with minimal effort."

619.speaker: Sal Ignacius
619.text: "The faithful have long been demanding the integration of Wruhecism into the Rizian school curriculum."

620.speaker: Narrator
620.text: He gave me a pointed look.

621.speaker: Player_Romus
621.text: "How precisely will you and the Wruhecist faithful help me if I do as you ask?"

622.speaker: Sal Ignacius
622.text: "You will find out, Your Majesty. Suffice it to say the reformists will no longer be a concern."

623.speaker: Player_Romus
623.text: "To quell the unrest, I need to earn the trust of all Rizians. Not only Wruhecists."

625.speaker: Player_Romus
625.text: "And who would oversee this powerful holy army? Yourself, I suppose?"

626.speaker: Narrator
626.text: He gestured to a bench some distance away. Titus was sitting there, nonchalantly keeping an eye on me.

631.speaker: Player_Romus
631.text: "My security councilor has enough on his plate. Are you seriously asking me to burden him with this?"

632.speaker: Player_Romus
632.text: "Captain Gordion has enough on his plate. I would not burden him with this."

633.speaker: Player_Romus
633.text: "You've given this some prior thought, haven't you?"

635.speaker: Player_Romus
635.text: "The Golden Guard? Why not the military?"

636.speaker: Sal Ignacius
636.text: "To him, it would be a blessing, not a burden."

637.speaker: Sal Ignacius
637.text: "I have seen it in Captain Gordion. The hunger for holy communion. The spark of the Divine."

638.speaker: Sal Ignacius
638.text: "I confess I have been thinking about it since I first met your bodyguard."

640.speaker: Sal Ignacius
640.text: "All respect to House Azaro, Your Majesty, but its members respect guns before God."

641.speaker: Narrator
641.text: He shut his eyes. His eyelids fluttered briefly, as if he were dreaming.

642.speaker: Sal Ignacius
642.text: "Yes. He is the one. With Sevrio's aid, Captain Gordion shall oversee a new citizens' militia, composed only of the most devout..."

644.speaker: Player_Romus
644.text: "A brilliant plan. If Titus consents to it, we shall form the Guardians immediately."

645.speaker: Player_Romus
645.text: "I want to know what Titus thinks of this first."

650.speaker: Player_Romus
650.text: "I'm sorry to say I am not in favor of your idea. The Golden Guard shall stay as is. I will find another way to deal with the reformists."

652.speaker: Titus Gordion
652.text: "Your Majesty, Grand Wiseman Ignacius. Is everything all right?"

653.speaker: Sal Ignacius
653.text: "Let us ask the man himself what he thinks."

654.speaker: Player_Romus
654.text: "Sal has convinced me the only way to end the unrest is to form a holy army. And he wants you to lead it."

655.speaker: Sal Ignacius
655.text: "You will not regret this, Your Majesty!"

657.speaker: Narrator
657.text: Sal beckoned for Titus to join us. He  bowed respectfully to each of us in turn.

658.speaker: Player_Romus
658.text: "Councilor Gordion. I would like you to assist in the creation of a task force dedicated to upholding the sanctity of Wruhecist law in Rizia."

662.speaker: Player_Romus
662.text: "Captain Gordion. I would like you to assist in the creation of a task force dedicated to upholding the sanctity of Wruhecist law in Rizia."

666.speaker: Player_Romus
666.text: "The day of our transformation will soon be at hand. God has chosen you to lead a brigade of the righteous, enforcing our religion in His name."

667.speaker: Player_Romus
667.text: "How would you feel about creating a religious subdivision of the Golden Guard? Nothing fancy."

671.speaker: Player_Romus
671.text: "Our kingdom is beset with traitors, Titus. It is time to smite them with the full force of God's will."

672.speaker: Narrator
672.text: Titus gasped and dropped to one knee.

673.speaker: Narrator
673.text: Sal took over, explaining his plan for Wruhec's Guardians. Titus gasped and dropped to one knee.

674.speaker: Titus Gordion
674.text: "I... I am not worthy of such an honor, Your Majesty."

675.speaker: Player_Romus
675.text: "It is I who would be honored if you took on this task."

676.speaker: Player_Romus
676.text: "Stand up, Titus. Rise and claim your destiny."

677.speaker: Player_Romus
677.text: "Of course you're worthy. Have you seen yourself in a mirror lately?"

678.speaker: Narrator
678.text: Titus stood up. I had never seen him display this much emotion before.

679.speaker: Player_Romus
679.text: "I didn't think so either. Grand Wiseman Ignacius, we're not going through with your plan."

680.speaker: Narrator
680.text: Both men looked at me, shocked.

683.speaker: Sal Ignacius
683.text: "My apologies, Captain Gordion. We will speak another time."

685.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
685.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_TalkToAdarfo_AskedManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.GeneralCouncilMeeting_Garden_Sal"] == true

686.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
686.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_TalkToAdarfo_AskedManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.GeneralCouncilMeeting_Garden_Sal"] == true) == false

687.speaker: Narrator
687.text: After he had left, I felt a tap on my shoulder. I turned and saw Sal Ignacius, looking even more solemn than usual.
687.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_TalkToAdarfo_AskedManus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.GeneralCouncilMeeting_Garden_Sal"] == true

688.speaker: Player_Romus
688.text: "Grand Wiseman. What news do you bring me?"

689.speaker: Player_Romus
689.text: "Were you listening to our conversation just now?"

690.speaker: Player_Romus
690.text: "Sal. Just the person I wanted to see."

691.speaker: Sal Ignacius
691.text: "No, but I suspect I know what the young man wanted."

692.speaker: Narrator
692.text: He scanned our surroundings to be sure no one was listening.

693.speaker: Sal Ignacius
693.text: "I must talk to you at once, Your Majesty."

694.speaker: Sal Ignacius
694.text: "Likewise, Your Majesty. I must speak with you at once."

695.speaker: Sal Ignacius
695.text: "I wanted to share my own thoughts on the current unrest."

696.speaker: Narrator
696.text: He scanned our surroundings to be sure no one was listening.

697.speaker: Player_Romus
697.text: "I have nothing to say to you, Grand Wiseman. Please leave me in peace."

698.speaker: Narrator
698.text: He hesitated, then backed off, bowing slowly.

699.speaker: Sal Ignacius
699.text: "Right away, Your Majesty. I am sorry to disturb you."

706.speaker: Sal Ignacius
706.text: "I am here to tell you that there is another way forward."

variablesModified.value: "Under the reign of King Romus Toras, the Golden Guard was enlarged into a division-sized unit and given expanded duties. Later, the special religious division Wruhec's Guardians was added."
"Under the reign of King Romus Toras, the Golden Guard expanded to include a new religious division, Wruhec's Guardians."

714.speaker: Sal Ignacius
714.text: "Sevrio Castellanus. The man I spoke of earlier. A figure who commands growing influence among Wruhecist commoners."

718.speaker: Sal Ignacius
718.text: "Sevrio Castellanus. A figure who commands growing influence among the Wruhecist faithful."

719.speaker: Sal Ignacius
719.text: "A true believer capable of leading the physical fight for God and country..."

722.speaker: Player_Romus
722.text: "This path could lead to too much trouble."

724.speaker: Sal Ignacius
724.text: "He has the necessary pull within the religious community. But he will need to join forces with another--"

725.speaker: Sal Ignacius
725.text: "The values of our cherished religion must be instilled at an early age."

727.speaker: Narrator
727.text: We began a leisurely stroll through the garden.

730.speaker: Player_Romus
730.text: "One more word about the state of religious affairs and I swear I'll stab out both my ears with a hot poker."

734.speaker: Sal Ignacius
734.text: "That won't be necessary, Your Majesty. This is very important."
